newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart to open eight stores in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart to open eight stores in Mexico.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc., the nation's largest retail chain, said Friday it will open eight Wal-Mart Supercenters in Mexico in 1997, expanding its 18-store network in Mexico.
The company said the stores will average 15,000 square feet and represent a total investment of $200 million by Wal-Mart and its Mexican partner, CIFRA SA de CV.
The companies already jointly operate 39 stores under various names in Mexico and 52 Vips restaurants. They also operate 28 SAM's Clubs in several cities in Mexico.
Bentonville, Ark.-based Wal-Mart's stock rose 25 cents to $23.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
